name: Assemble board
description: Composite leaf that stitches the approved cards into the final film.json (playback order, shared font) the render consumes; reviewed for board consistency.
produce: Stitch the approved cards into the final film.json, in playback order: each beat references its card's plate file (plates/<id>.html) and camera, with the one shared @font-face. Do not regenerate cards — assemble what the card nodes produced. Output the film.json the render consumes.
